output.title: Insulin copay cap on a Prescription Drug Plan (PDP)
output.draft_text:
Question: What is the insulin copay cap on a PDP?

Before you answer: Verify the caller first. Do not quote a copay, a tier, or a coverage limit to an unverified caller, and do not say whether a drug is on the formulary (see U-RX-EDU-001-07).

Answer for a verified caller:
On the member's PDP, the cost-sharing cap for a covered insulin is [cap amount] per [supply period, e.g., one-month supply]. The cap applies to insulins that are [coverage condition, e.g., on the plan formulary] and dispensed at [eligible pharmacy types]. The cap applies [whether the cap applies before the deductible is met] and in [coverage phases where the cap applies].

For supplies longer than [supply period], the cap is [cap amount for extended supplies].

Insulin given through [delivery method excluded or covered differently, e.g., insulin pump] is covered under [benefit that applies] and the cap [whether the cap applies to that delivery method].

Suggested wording for the advocate: "For your covered insulin, your plan limits what you pay to [cap amount] for a [supply period]."

If the member asks "is that my copay?": You may say the estimate reflects the copay or coinsurance on the plan record (see U-RX-EDU-001-10).

Do not promise that the pharmacy will charge that amount (see U-RX-EDU-001-11). If the member is charged more than the cap at the pharmacy, [escalation or next step for overcharge].
placeholders: [coverage condition, e.g., on the plan formulary]
[whether the cap applies before the deductible is met]
[delivery method excluded or covered differently, e.g., insulin pump]
[whether the cap applies to that delivery method]
author_checklist: Confirm the exact insulin cost-sharing cap amount for PDP members and its source document.
Confirm the supply period the cap applies to and the cap for 60- or 90-day supplies.
Confirm which insulins the cap covers, including whether they must be on the formulary.
Confirm whether the cap applies before the deductible and in every coverage phase.
Confirm which pharmacy types the cap applies to (retail, mail order, in-network only, etc.).
Confirm how insulin used with a pump or other device is covered and whether the cap applies.
Confirm whether the cap differs by plan, plan year, or member subsidy status.
Confirm the escalation path when a member is charged more than the cap.
Confirm the identity verification requirement is consistent with U-RX-EDU-001-07.
Confirm the wording does not promise a pharmacy charge, per U-RX-EDU-001-11.
Confirm the effective date and review date for this unit.
